issue_text: incompleteFork's second disjunct — `(snap.Seq == snap.ForkedAtSeq+1 && snap.StateKind == run.KindAgentEdit)` — detects a fork into an agent-edit (fix) checkpoint that wrote the rebaseline tree event (child Seq == ForkedAtSeq+1) but crashed before writing the required fix_baseline event (which would make Seq == ForkedAtSeq+2). No test ever drives incompleteFork to return true through this clause: it can be DELETED entirely and the full package test suite still passes. All incomplete-fork tests use non-agent-edit checkpoints and hit only the first disjunct (Seq <= ForkedAtSeq): fork_test.go:899-921 forks From:"adjudicate" with an append failure mid-copy, and machine_test.go:1847-1869 crafts a discover-state child with ForkedAtSeq == len(parent). Every fork into the "fix" agent-edit state in the suite (fork_test.go:135, 292, 309) is COMPLETE (writes fix_baseline), and none is combined with a store append failure at the fix_baseline position. So the specific agent-edit corruption this clause guards is never exercised.
why_real: Category 2 (untested/deletable invariant) with a concrete corruption behind it. Fork writes the child events in a loop (fork.go:270-275); a store Append failure at the LAST event (the fix_baseline stamped at fork.go:240) leaves a child with the rebaseline tree present but the fix baseline absent — a real, reachable half-written state. incompleteFork runs before the sidecar read in loadWith (machine.go:372) precisely to reject such children with ERR_FORK_INCOMPLETE. With this disjunct removed, that child Opens successfully and resumes the fix node with no FixEntryHead re-established, silently defeating the fork-safety invariant the code comments describe (machine.go:661-665, 1057-1058). Verifiable: read incompleteFork + grep tests for a fork-into-agent-edit incomplete case (none exists). Per the repo's own #24 doctrine ('a gate never seen failing is not a gate'), a test must fork into the fix checkpoint, fail the append at the fix_baseline event, and assert Open -> ERR_FORK_INCOMPLETE.
tests_checked: Read machine_test.go:TestOpenIncompleteFork (1840-1880) — clause-1 only (discover, Seq==ForkedAtSeq). Read fork_test.go TestF10ForkFailureSweeps (848-985) — every append/lock/create failure forks From:"adjudicate" (non-agent-edit); failAt=2 hits clause 1. Read fork_test.go:135-140 (complete fix fork, writes fix_baseline) and 920 (adjudicate incomplete via clause 1). Confirmed StateKind is set to ToKind on the copied transition into the checkpoint (run/fold.go:218) and agent-edit kind = run.KindAgentEdit, so the guard is live, not dead code. No test makes the second disjunct true; note that INVERTING `==`->`!=` instead breaks the successful adjudicate fork, but whole-clause DELETION passes.
